name: ASSA/AEA 2027 Annual Meeting
organizer: American Economic Association (AEA) / Allied Social Science Associations (ASSA)
deadline_note: Individual paper proposals due April 1, 2026; complete session proposals due April 15, 2026. Call closed.
submission_requirements: Abstract of up to 300 words via the AEA submission system; full papers are not accepted at the time of submission
registration_fee: USD 250 regular / USD 75 student (early, ends Dec 1); USD 300 regular / USD 125 student (standard/on-site)
membership_required: At least one author of each paper must be an AEA member
